messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to flip config flag `enable_fast_path` for EU pools at 22:00 PT tonight. Need someone to push, run smoke, and hold rollback. Who's up? :eyes:
kevin: I can push and be primary owner. Will do a canary to 5% first. :+1:
jamal: I'll own smoke and metrics watch. I'll run the usual checklist and post results.
anya: Thanks — can you follow this minimal smoke checklist? 1) health endpoints 2) 50 short gen requests 3) tail 2 error logs 4) confirm latency P95 under SLO
kevin: copying the checklist. I'll run canary script:
```
./toggle_flag --env=prod-eu --flag=enable_fast_path --pct=5 --who=kevin
```
then bump to 50/100/100% if green.
jamal: plan for rollbacks: set flag to safe-default (off) and restart router only if errors spike.
maria: safe-default is OFF. tagging @sre-oncall for escalation channel and breakpoint.
sre-oncall: I'm on pager. If you see error rate >2% or token errors spike, ping me and I'll help roll back and check infra.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by kevin at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z — canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Logs: /deploys/2894012345
kevin: I'll post time marks and sample responses. Jamal, can you run the 50 short gens at each stage and paste summary?
jamal: yep — will paste timestamps and p95/err counts. Expect first pass ~22:02 PT.
anya: quick note: keep KV cache disabled for canary to avoid cross-tenant cache leaks (set `cache_prefetch=false`).
maria: thanks. If no objections, kevin kicks at 22:00 PT. We'll aim for full 22:20 PT finish. :clock1:
kevin: ack. starting at 22:00 PT. ping me in thread for go/no-go.
jamal: ready. I'll watch dashboards and post a short summary. :mag:
maria: appreciate it — mark this thread resolved after final 100% confirmation.
